name: cicero
description: CICERO — the house voice. A SessionStart hook injects the always-on communication style (readable-first, bottom line first, concise, plain language, recommend-don't-survey, push back, honesty, stay in scope) + a start banner, and resolves the voice language (asks once, then persists). A Stop hook enforces principles 0/12/2/3 by blocking an off-voice reply so it gets rewritten, driven by per-language dictionaries: an English-only shipped half (which terms to flag + how) merged with the user's growing ~/.claude/cicero dictionary (their translate/gloss/allow choices).
